name: The Fool
meaning_upright: New beginnings, optimism, trust in life
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, being taken advantage of, inconsideration
description: The Fool represents the start of a journey, stepping off a cliff into the unknown with pure faith.

name: The Magician
meaning_upright: Action, the power to manifest, resourcefulness
description: The Magician connects the spiritual and physical worlds, using tools to manifest their will.

name: The High Priestess
description: The High Priestess sits at the gate of the subconscious, urging you to listen to your inner voice.

name: The Empress
description: The Empress is the mother figure of the tarot, representing fertility and the abundance of nature.

name: The Emperor
meaning_reversed: Domination, excessive control, lack of discipline
description: The Emperor brings order to chaos, representing structure, rules, and masculine energy.

name: The Hierophant
meaning_reversed: Personal beliefs, freedom, challenging the status quo
description: The Hierophant represents tradition and established institutions, acting as a bridge to the divine.

name: The Lovers
meaning_reversed: Self-love, disharmony, imbalance, misalignment of values
description: The Lovers represent distinct choices and the union of dualities, usually in relationships.

name: The Chariot
meaning_reversed: Self-discipline issues, aggression, lack of direction
description: The Chariot represents overcoming conflict and moving forward through sheer willpower.

name: Strength
description: Strength reminds you that true power comes from inner calm and patience, not brute force.

name: The Hermit
description: The Hermit walks alone to find the light of truth, representing a time for self-reflection.

name: Wheel of Fortune
meaning_upright: Good luck, karma, life cycles, destiny
meaning_reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking cycles
description: The Wheel turns for everyone; it represents the inevitable cycles of fate and change.

name: Justice
meaning_upright: Justice, fairness, truth, cause and effect
description: Justice holds the scales of truth, reminding us that every action has a consequence.

name: The Hanged Man
meaning_upright: Pause, surrender, letting go, new perspectives
description: The Hanged Man suggests a suspension of action to gain a new perspective through sacrifice.

name: Death
description: Death is rarely physical; it represents the end of a cycle and the beginning of a new one.

name: Temperance
description: Temperance is the alchemist, blending opposites to find balance and harmony in life.

name: The Devil
meaning_reversed: Releasing limiting beliefs, exploring dark thoughts
description: The Devil represents the chains we forge for ourselves through addiction or materialism.

name: The Tower
description: The Tower brings destruction to false structures, clearing the way for truth.

name: The Star
description: The Star follows the Tower, bringing hope, renewal, and spiritual healing.

name: The Moon
meaning_reversed: Release of fear, repressed emotion, confusion
description: The Moon represents the realm of dreams and illusions where things are not always as they seem.

name: The Sun
meaning_reversed: Inner child, feeling down, overly optimistic
description: The Sun is the best card in the deck, radiating joy, success, and positivity.

name: Judgement
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, inner critic, ignoring the call
description: Judgement calls for a rising up, a moment of reckoning and awakening to a new life.

name: The World
description: The World represents the successful conclusion of a long journey and total fulfillment.

name: Ace of Wands
meaning_reversed: An emerging idea, lack of direction, distractions
description: A hand holding a sprouting wand, representing the spark of new creative energy.

name: Two of Wands
meaning_reversed: Fear of unknown, lack of planning
description: A figure holds a globe, contemplating the vastness of the world and their next move.

name: Three of Wands
description: A figure looks out to sea as ships return, symbolizing waiting for the results of one's efforts.

name: Four of Wands
meaning_reversed: Personal celebration, inner harmony, conflict with family
description: A couple dances beneath a wreath, representing stability, happiness, and celebration.

name: Five of Wands
description: Five figures wield wands in a chaotic manner, symbolizing strife and competition.

name: Six of Wands
description: A victor rides a horse through a cheering crowd, representing triumph and recognition.

name: Seven of Wands
description: A figure stands on a hill defending themselves against six attacking wands.

name: Eight of Wands
meaning_upright: Movement, fast paced change, action, alignment
description: Eight wands fly through the air, representing speed, motion, and swift communication.

name: Nine of Wands
meaning_upright: Resilience, courage, persistence, test of faith
description: A wounded figure leans on a wand, representing exhaustion but the will to keep fighting.

name: Ten of Wands
meaning_upright: Burden, extra responsibility, hard work, completion
meaning_reversed: Doing it all, carrying the burden, delegation
description: A figure carries a heavy bundle of wands, symbolizing the weight of responsibilities.

name: Page of Wands
description: A young messenger looks at a wand, full of enthusiasm and the spark of a new idea.

name: Knight of Wands
meaning_upright: Energy, passion, inspired action, adventure, impulsiveness
description: A knight charges forward on a horse, ready to take action on their passions.

name: Queen of Wands
description: The Queen sits on her throne with a sunflower, radiating warmth, vibrancy, and confidence.

name: King of Wands
description: The King sits holding a blossoming wand, representing big picture vision and leadership.

name: Ace of Cups
description: A cup overflows with five streams of water, symbolizing an abundance of emotion and spirit.

name: Two of Cups
description: Two figures exchange cups, representing connection, partnership, and unity.

name: Three of Cups
description: Three women dance together with cups raised, symbolizing friendship and community.

name: Four of Cups
meaning_reversed: Retreat, withdrawal, checking in for alignment
description: A figure sits under a tree ignoring a offered cup, representing boredom or contemplation.

name: Five of Cups
description: A cloaked figure mourns three spilled cups while two stand upright behind them.

name: Six of Cups
meaning_upright: Revisiting the past, childhood memories, innocence, joy
meaning_reversed: Living in the past, forgiveness, lacking playfulness
description: Children play in a garden with cups filled with flowers, representing nostalgia.

name: Seven of Cups
meaning_reversed: Alignment, personal values, overwhelmed by choices
description: A figure sees seven cups in the clouds containing various strange gifts and curses.

name: Eight of Cups
meaning_reversed: Trying one more time, indecision, aimless drifting
description: A figure walks away from a stack of cups into the mountains, seeking something more.

name: Nine of Cups
meaning_upright: Contentment, satisfaction, gratitude, wish come true
description: A figure sits contentedly in front of nine cups, often called the 'wish card'.

name: Ten of Cups
meaning_upright: Divine love, blissful relationships, harmony, alignment
description: A happy family stands beneath a rainbow of cups, representing emotional fulfillment.

name: Page of Cups
meaning_reversed: New ideas, doubting intuition, creative blocks
description: A youth holds a cup with a fish popping out, symbolizing a surprise or creative message.

name: Knight of Cups
description: A knight rides slowly, offering a cup, representing a romantic or artistic proposal.

name: Queen of Cups
description: The Queen gazes into a cup, representing deep emotional introspection and care.

name: King of Cups
description: The King sits calmly on a throne floating on water, mastering the realm of emotions.

name: Ace of Swords
meaning_upright: Breakthroughs, new ideas, mental clarity, success
meaning_reversed: Inner clarity, re-thinking an idea, clouded judgement
description: A hand holds a sword upright, crowned with a wreath, representing clarity and truth.

name: Two of Swords
meaning_upright: Difficult decisions, weighing up options, an impasse
description: A blindfolded figure holds two crossed swords, representing a stalemate or hard choice.

name: Three of Swords
meaning_upright: Heartbreak, emotional pain, sorrow, grief, hurt
description: A heart is pierced by three swords against a stormy sky, representing sorrow.

name: Four of Swords
description: A knight lies in a tomb in prayer, representing a need for rest and retreat.

name: Five of Swords
meaning_upright: Conflict, disagreements, competition, defeat, winning at all costs
description: A figure collects swords from defeated opponents, representing a hollow victory.

name: Six of Swords
meaning_upright: Transition, change, rite of passage, releasing baggage
description: A figure travels by boat to calmer waters, leaving difficulties behind.

name: Seven of Swords
meaning_upright: Betrayal, deception, getting away with something, stealth
meaning_reversed: Mental challenges, breaking free, keeping secrets
description: A figure sneaks away with five swords, looking back at the two left behind.

name: Eight of Swords
meaning_reversed: Self-limiting beliefs, inner critic, releasing negative thoughts
description: A bound and blindfolded figure stands surrounded by swords, trapping themselves.

name: Nine of Swords
meaning_reversed: Inner turmoil, deep-seated fears, secrets, releasing worry
description: A figure sits up in bed with head in hands, overwhelmed by worry and grief.

name: Ten of Swords
meaning_upright: Painful endings, deep wounds, betrayal, loss, crisis
meaning_reversed: Recovery, regeneration, resisting an inevitable end
description: A figure lies defeated with ten swords in their back, symbolizing a rock-bottom ending.

name: Page of Swords
meaning_upright: New ideas, curiosity, thirst for knowledge, new ways of communicating
meaning_reversed: Self-expression, all talk and no action, haphazard action
description: A youth holds a sword, ready to defend their ideas and seek the truth.

name: Knight of Swords
meaning_upright: Ambitious, action-oriented, driven to succeed, fast-thinking
description: A knight charges furiously into the wind, representing haste and intellectual action.

name: Queen of Swords
meaning_upright: Independent, unbiased judgement, clear boundaries, direct communication
description: The Queen sits with a sword raised, representing intellect, clarity, and independence.

name: King of Swords
meaning_upright: Mental clarity, intellectual power, authority, truth
meaning_reversed: Quiet power, inner truth, misuse of power, manipulation
description: The King sits sternly with a sword, representing structure, truth, and ethical leadership.

name: Ace of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A new financial or career opportunity, manifestation, abundance
meaning_reversed: Lost opportunity, lack of planning and foresight
description: A hand offers a large pentacle in a garden, representing a gift of material stability.

name: Two of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Multiple priorities, time management, prioritization, adaptability
description: A figure juggles two pentacles in an infinity loop, managing ups and downs.

name: Three of Pentacles
description: A craftsman works on a cathedral with two others, representing collaboration.

name: Four of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Saving money, security, conservatism, scarcity, control
description: A figure clutches four pentacles tightly, afraid to let go of their possessions.

name: Five of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Financial loss, poverty, lack mindset, isolation, worry
meaning_reversed: Recovery from financial loss, spiritual poverty
description: Two destitute figures walk in the snow outside a warm church window.

name: Six of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Giving, receiving, sharing wealth, generosity, charity
description: A merchant weighs coins to give to beggars, representing the balance of giving.

name: Seven of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Long-term view, sustainable results, perseverance, investment
meaning_reversed: Lack of long-term vision, limited success or reward
description: A farmer leans on his hoe, looking at his crop, waiting for the harvest.

name: Eight of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Apprenticeship, repetitive tasks, mastery, skill development
description: A craftsman diligently hammers away at a pentacle, focused on his work.

name: Nine of Pentacles
description: A woman stands in a vineyard with a falcon, enjoying the fruits of her labor.

name: Ten of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Wealth, financial security, family, long-term success, contribution
meaning_reversed: The dark side of wealth, financial failure or loss
description: An elder sits with family and dogs, representing legacy and generational wealth.

name: Page of Pentacles
meaning_reversed: Lack of progress, procrastination, learn from failure
description: A youth examines a pentacle closely, representing study and new financial beginnings.

name: Knight of Pentacles
description: A knight sits on a heavy horse, representing slow, steady, and reliable progress.

name: Queen of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Nurturing, practical, providing financially, a working parent
description: The Queen sits amidst nature, caring for a pentacle, representing practical nurturing.

name: King of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Wealth, business, leadership, security, discipline, abundance
meaning_reversed: Financially inept, obsessed with wealth and status, stubborn
description: The King sits on a throne adorned with bulls, representing material success and power.
